import json, subprocess, sys
def build(P, K=1):
    fields=[{"name":"a","type":"FLAG"},{"name":"b","type":"FLAG"}]
    atoms=[{"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"a","at":0},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}},
           {"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"b","at":0},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}}]
    train=[{"id":"t","source":"s","rows":[{"t":i,"values":[True,True]} for i in range(3)]}]
    probes=[{"id":"p","source":"s","rows":[{"t":i,"values":[False,False]} for i in range(P)]}]
    return {"version":1,"window":K,"schema":fields,"atoms":atoms,
            "policy":{"max_width":2,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},
            "train":train,"probes":probes,"queries":[]}
for P in range(1, 20):
    req = build(P)
    p=subprocess.run(['/app/submission/run.sh'],input=json.dumps(req).encode(),capture_output=True,cwd='/app/submission')
    r=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    sigs=[c['signature'] for c in r['classes']]
    exp_w = (P+3)//4
    ok = all(len(s)==exp_w for s in sigs) and len(sigs)>=1
    print('P=%2d width=%d expected=%d sigs=%s %s' % (P, len(sigs[0]) if sigs else -1, exp_w, sigs[:2], 'OK' if ok else 'FAIL'))
EOF
